leadText: Join the Band is the English ending theme for Pikachu and the Pokémon Music Squad. It borrows musically from the equivalent Japanese ending theme, Roaring All-Stars. It is included on the Pokémon Movie Music Collection album.
plainText:
Join the Band is the English ending theme for Pikachu and the Pokémon Music Squad. It borrows musically from the equivalent Japanese ending theme, Roaring All-Stars. It is included on the Pokémon Movie Music Collection album.

==Lyrics==
 Tell me, do you like singin'?
Do you like to dance?
Do you like making lots of noise?
Come join the band

You can be a big rock star
Give yourself a chance
Raise your hands up, girls and boys
And join the band

'Cause music is the only language everybody understands
So get on board (get on board)
Get ready to rock and join the band

Do you wanna make magic?
Do you wanna groove?
Do you wanna just jump around and scream?
Get in the band

Do you wanna tell stories?
Do you maybe wanna, bust a move?
Do you wanna live your dream?
Come join the band

'Cause music is the only language everybody understands
Get on board (get on board)
Get ready to rock and join the band

Tell me, do you like singin'?
Do you like to dance?
Do you like makin' people happy?
Come join the band

You know that you're a rock star
Give yourself a chance
Raise your hands up, girls and boys
And join the band 

==Credits==
Music and lyrics by Ed Goldfarb
Lead vocals by Haven Paschall
Mixed by Jeff Stewart Saltzman
